neet_phy_u11_t02_2.working: The axial field E ∝ x/(R²+x²)^{3/2} is maximum at x = R/√2 = 20/√2 = 10√2 cm

neet_phy_u11_t02_5.working: I: for x >> R the ring field is kQ/x², so I is correct. II: Q = σ·4πr² = 2e-6 × 4π × 0.01 = 8π×10⁻⁸ C, so II is correct.
